queries.query: large language model AND (network configuration OR NetOps OR "network operations") AND (error OR misconfiguration OR failure OR "fault" OR "incorrect")
queries.rationale: Identify documented classes of operational failures and misconfigurations produced by LLMs when used to generate or modify network configurations.

queries.query: "hallucinat*" OR fabricate* OR "invented command" AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "foundation model") AND (network OR "network configuration" OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Find studies reporting hallucination/fabrication behaviors of LLMs in the NetOps context (made-up commands, non-existent interfaces, fabricated facts).

queries.query: "generate-validate-repair" OR "generate-then-validate" OR "verify-and-repair" AND (LLM OR "language model" OR agent) AND (network OR "configuration")
queries.rationale: Survey architectures that combine generation, external validators/verifiers, and repair loops for safer NetOps actions.

queries.query: Batfish OR "header space analysis" OR NetKAT OR "formal verification" AND (network configuration OR policy OR "reachability")
queries.rationale: Collect primary references and methods for deterministic/formal verification of network configurations that can serve as validators or oracles in experiments.

queries.query: "network change validation" OR "configuration verification" OR "policy compliance" AND (tool OR framework OR Batfish OR Veriflow)
queries.rationale: Locate practical validators and testing frameworks used in NetOps to assess configuration changes and policy compliance.

queries.query: AIOps OR "AIOps" AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR agent) AND (network OR NetOps OR "network management")
queries.rationale: Map the AIOps literature where ML/LLM techniques are applied to network monitoring, automation, and incident response for adjacent methods and failure analyses.

queries.query: "agentic" OR "autonomous agent" AND (network OR NetOps OR "network management") AND (safety OR reliability OR "orchestration")
queries.rationale: Find prior work on autonomous/agentic systems applied to NetOps, including orchestration architectures and safety constraints.

queries.query: benchmark OR evaluation AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (network OR NetOps OR "network configuration") AND ("construct validity" OR "threats to validity" OR "benchmark validity")
queries.rationale: Investigate existing benchmark designs and critiques relevant to evaluating LLMs for NetOps, focusing on construct and external validity issues.

queries.query: "6G-Bench" OR "TSNBench" OR "OpsEval" OR "OWL" AND (AIOps OR NetOps OR "LLM")
queries.rationale: Locate and review named benchmark suites and datasets mentioned in the programme as leads, and identify their applicability/limitations for LLM-driven NetOps evaluation.

queries.query: adversarial OR "attack" OR poisoning AND (network configuration OR NetOps) AND (LLM OR "language model" OR automation)
queries.rationale: Explore adversarial threats where malicious inputs, crafted intents, or model vulnerabilities lead to unsafe network changes; informs threat models and robustness tests.

queries.query: "mininet" OR "ns-3" OR "network emulator" OR "network simulator" AND (evaluation OR testbed OR benchmark) AND (NetOps OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Identify simulation and emulation environments used to evaluate configuration changes safely, for experimental design options and validators.

queries.query: metrics OR measurement AND ("reachability" OR "isolation" OR "policy compliance" OR "connectivity") AND (network configuration OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Collect operational metrics that map to safety/correctness for network configuration changes to define evaluation criteria.

queries.query: "self‑repair" OR "iterative repair" OR "program repair" AND (LLM OR "language model" OR agent) AND (configuration OR code OR program)
queries.rationale: Survey automated repair techniques in software engineering and LLM-assisted program/configuration repair methods transferable to NetOps.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop OR "operator-in-the-loop" AND (NetOps OR network OR "configuration change") AND (LLM OR automation)
queries.rationale: Identify literature about effective human oversight, approval workflows, and operator-in-the-loop designs relevant to safe deployment of LLM-generated NetOps actions.

queries.query: explainability OR interpretability AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (decision OR "configuration change" OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Find work on making LLM outputs interpretable for operators (justification, provenance, traceable edits) to support trust and auditability.

queries.query: LLM evaluation methodology AND (paired design OR within-subject OR "case-based" OR "counterfactual") AND (network OR NetOps OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Gather methodological best practices for rigorous evaluation designs that control for variability and enable paired comparisons in NetOps studies.
source_preferences: methodology papers in AI evaluation forums

queries.query: LLM provenance OR "chain-of-thought" logging AND (audit OR "forensics" OR "reproducibility") AND NetOps
queries.rationale: Seek practices and tools for logging provenance, reasoning traces, and reproducibility for auditability in operational settings.

queries.query: case studies OR field reports AND (LLM OR automation) AND (network operations OR NetOps OR "network management")
queries.rationale: Identify real-world pilot studies, case reports, or deployments showing practical constraints, operator reactions, and failure modes.
source_preferences: operator blogs only if accompanied by technical reports

inclusion_criteria: Primary peer-reviewed papers or preprints with verifiable metadata (title, authors, year, venue/identifier).
Work that provides empirical results, reproducible artifacts, or concrete tools (code, datasets, simulators).
Papers addressing LLMs/agents applied to network configuration, validation, verification, AIOps, or adjacent automation tasks.
Benchmarks, datasets, or methodological papers discussing construct/external validity for evaluation.
Security/adversarial papers relevant to operational risk in NetOps.
Human-in-the-loop, explainability, and provenance papers with operational focus.
exclusion_criteria: Non-technical marketing materials, press releases, or unverifiable blog posts lacking primary evidence.
Closed-source proprietary results with no accessible artifacts unless peer-reviewed and replicable.
Papers outside the NetOps/AIOps/verification/evaluation neighbourhood unless they offer transferable, well-argued methods (e.g., program repair).
Pre-lock private development artifacts (per programme constraints) and unverifiable internal reports.
date_rationale: Primary focus on work from 2018–2026 to cover the LLM/foundation-model era and recent AIOps/agentic-automation literature; include earlier foundational work (≈2000–2018) for classical verification, formal methods, header-space analysis, and network testing that remain relevant as validators.
